content_blocks.body_md: Acetaminophen, sold as Tylenol or paracetamol, is the most common drug in the medicine cabinet and, in overdose, the leading cause of acute liver failure. It eases pain and fever without the stomach irritation of the NSAIDs, but its safety margin is narrower than most people assume.

why_it_matters.text: The pain and fever reliever sold as Tylenol and Panadol, and the most-visited page on MoleculeFinder. Outside the US it is usually called paracetamol.

approval.basis: Marketed today (over-the-counter) under NDA 018337 in the Drugs@FDA data files.
